scripts.//assets:albums: The four sleeves in the pile, squared and taken to WebP at 640. Square because a record sleeve is, and the scans are not: the Pink Floyd one is 461x600, so it is cropped to the interesting part rather than squashed.
scripts.//assets:og: The card a link turns into in a chat, and the icon in the tab. Drawn rather than screenshotted: a screenshot of the station is a dark player, and an unfurl renders around five hundred pixels wide. Needs Pillow; writes public/og.png and public/apple-touch-icon.png.
scripts.//qa:callin: A listener brought up, in two browsers: one whose microphone can hear the station and is refused, and one on headphones who passes, goes up, and whose own music goes silent. The capture file is written at run time.
scripts.//qa:cohost: The seat, on a phone: the link redeemed and taken out of the address bar, one gesture that names you and wakes the audio, push-to-talk held rather than clicked, and the transition taken by hand. Runs in a 390x844 viewport, because that is the only device this page is for.
scripts.//qa:transition: One record becoming the next, in two browsers at once. The claim no unit test can make: both decks running, the outgoing one never reloaded, the faders crossing through equal power, and two listeners at the same point in the fade.
